entities.summary: Allen Lucas Messer is an American politician and lobbyist who represented Indiana's 6th congressional district in the United States House of Representatives from 2013 to 2019. He is a member of the Republican Party. Luke Messer was a heads of state & government from Evansville (b. 1969-02-27, Evansville). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to political systems and geopolitics.
